content: News 2026 2025 2024 2023 2022 2021 2020 2019 2018 2017 2016 2015 2014 2013 2012 2011 2010 2009 2008 2007 2006 2005 2004 2003 2002 2001 2000 &nbspPrevious Article Next Article Explore Inktober SciArt images 09/30 Inktober is an annual ink drawing challenge to follow a list of 31 drawing prompts, one for every day of October, and publish the work on social media. Structural biologist Irina Bezsonova (UCONN Health) created PDB-themed images for past iterations. These images are hosted in a SciArt Gallery at PDB-101 . These images of her amazing PDB-inspired drawings are available for download.
